correctness.rationale: The prefix-indicator decomposition is an exact isometry from path variation to the ℓ1 sum of adjacent increments; constants are preserved. For a binary partition, all output edge jumps equal the two class-mean difference, and the bounds t≤2b and t≤2(x+y)+1 yield tδ≤(6−4√2)n+1. The word A^(n−2b)(BA)^b at b≈(1−1/√2)n yields the matching lower rate with loss ≤2. Direct evaluation of all four three-class residue words at a join-cut gives B_n=n/2 except n≡3 mod4, where B_n=n/2−1/(n−1). Independently exhaustively enumerated binary words at n=3,4,5,6,7, obtaining maxima 1,3/2,2,9/4,5/2; all are below the three-class constructions from n=4. The proven inequality (1/2−α)n>1+1/(n−1) covers n≥8. The proof does not determine the unrestricted M3(n) envelope.
